meta.policy: Status 'verified' = the claim was confirmed against the cited official source body fetched this session. 'verified-limited' = confirmed in part; the remainder is blank/flagged. 'unverified-blank' = could not be confirmed from an official source this session; the value is left blank and flagged. No value is inferred.

findings.claim: Neither China nor the U.S. taxes the act of converting CNY to USD itself
findings.value: $0 conversion tax
findings.note: SAFE imposes quota + authenticity review (S01); FE Regs Art. 5 does not restrict current transfers (S05); U.S. personal FX gain excluded unless >$200 (S16).

findings.claim: Annual individual FX facilitation quota
findings.value: USD 50,000 equivalent per person per year
findings.note: Huifa [2007] No. 1 Art. 2 (settlement + domestic-individual purchases). Within quota: ID-only at bank.

findings.claim: Foreign individual documented current-account RMB income conversion
findings.value: ID + source materials incl. tax vouchers; no annual cap stated
findings.note: Huifa [2007] No. 1 Art. 13(1); SAFE 2026 FAQ citing Guidelines (2020) Art. 59. Cap = documented lawful income amount.

findings.claim: Which foreign individuals get the $50k quota
findings.value: Only Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card holders
findings.note: SAFE 2024 case (9). A U.S. citizen without that card uses V03, not V02. Corrects any blanket 'everyone gets $50k' claim.

findings.claim: Reconversion of unused previously-exchanged RMB
findings.value: <=USD 500/day onshore; <=USD 1,000 airside; memo valid 24 months
findings.note: Art. 13(2). Only for RMB previously converted FROM foreign currency and unused — not a general conversion allowance.

findings.claim: Outward remittance from FX savings account
findings.value: Domestic <=USD 50,000/day ID-only; foreign individual ID-based
findings.note: Arts. 14-15. Above domestic threshold: authenticity documents.

findings.claim: Anti-splitting rule
findings.value: Prohibited: splitting large amounts into small batches; fabricated bills/vouchers
findings.note: PBOC Decree [2006] No. 3 Art. 7. Basis for rejecting quota pooling (M15) and false documents (M17).

findings.claim: Emigrant / inheritor asset transfer eligibility
findings.value: Narrow: pre-immigration assets (emigrant); inherited China assets (inheritor); SAFE approval at original residence
findings.note: 2004 PBOC rules fetched. 2014 lump-sum amendment NOT re-fetched → installment detail left blank (F04). Most U.S.-born citizens do not qualify as emigrants.

findings.claim: PRC individual income tax rates on source income
findings.value: 3-45% comprehensive; 5-35% business; 20% flat passive/gains; RMB 60,000 deduction
findings.note: IIT Law Arts. 3, 6. Owed when income arises, not at remittance. Personal amount depends on private facts → blank (F01).

findings.claim: Current-account transfers not restricted in principle
findings.value: State does not restrict current international payments/transfers
findings.note: FE Regs Art. 5. Capital-account transfers are separately controlled.

findings.claim: PRC fines for evasion / fraudulent purchase / illegal dealing
findings.value: Up to 30%; serious 30-100% + criminal; unlawful carrying up to 20%
findings.note: Decree 532 Arts. 39, 40, 45 (30%/30-100%); Art. 42 (carrying, 20%). Dollar exposures computed in costs tables from these bands.

findings.claim: Who counts as a domestic individual (residence test)
findings.value: Foreign national continuously resident in China >=1 year
findings.note: Decree 532 Art. 52(2). Affects quota vs documented-income analysis. Prior dashboards stating 'always non-domestic' are incomplete.

findings.claim: Overseas ATM cash withdrawal caps (domestic cards)
findings.value: RMB 100,000/person/calendar year; RMB 10,000/card/day
findings.note: Huifa [2017] No. 29. Excess suspends withdrawals current + following year.

findings.claim: Foreign-cash carry-out permit bands
findings.value: <=USD 5,000 no permit; USD 5,000-10,000 bank permit; >USD 10,000 in principle not allowed
findings.note: Hui Fa [2003] No. 102 Arts. 5, 7. Repeat-traveler limits lower (Art. 6).

findings.claim: FBAR filing trigger and due date
findings.value: >$10,000 aggregate any time; due Apr 15, auto-extension Oct 15; FinCEN 114 via BSA E-Filing
findings.note: Income production irrelevant. U.S. citizen with China account is in scope before any conversion.

findings.claim: FBAR civil penalty maximums (assessed on/after 2025-01-17)
findings.value: Non-willful $16,536/report; willful greater of $165,353 or 50% of balance
findings.note: 31 CFR 1010.821 Table 1 ($16,536 / $165,353) + IRM 5.21.6.4 (50% statutory rule). Bittner: non-willful per report, not per account (IRM 4.26.16 transmittal, search-surfaced — see F07).

findings.claim: Form 8938 reporting thresholds
findings.value: U.S. unmarried >$50k/>$75k; MFJ >$100k/>$150k; abroad unmarried >$200k/>$300k; MFJ abroad >$400k/>$600k
findings.note: Year-end / any-time tests. No return required = no 8938 required. Does not relieve FBAR.

findings.claim: Form 8938 penalty maximum
findings.value: $10,000 initial + $10,000/30 days; max total $60,000 per form
findings.note: IRC 6038D(d) via IRM 8.11.5.9. Continuation starts 90 days after IRS notice.

findings.claim: U.S. personal foreign-currency gain exclusion
findings.value: No gain recognized on personal transaction unless gain >$200
findings.note: 26 U.S.C. 988(e)(2), 2024 edition. Business/investment currency is different (ordinary under 988(a)).

findings.claim: Foreign tax credit limit
findings.value: Credit = foreign tax or U.S. tax x (foreign-source/total); Form 1116; carryback 1yr, carryforward 10yr
findings.note: Credit, not refund. Treaty special rules may apply.

findings.claim: HSBC China outward TT published fees (Premier/Advance)
findings.value: 0.1% min CNY 100 max CNY 500 + CNY 120 cable per transaction; PB individual Free; Pay Exact CNY 200 optional
findings.note: Tariff eff. 31 Oct 2026, items 2.2.4.1-2.2.4.2. Premier eligibility conditional (Note 3). Excludes other institutions' charges (Note 7).

findings.claim: HSBC Global Transfer to own overseas HSBC account
findings.value: Private Banking Free; Premier Free; Advance USD 20/transaction
findings.note: Item 2.2.6.1. Advance transaction count unknown (per-transaction limit unpublished) → Advance total blank (F02).

findings.claim: USD 7 HSBC reference price scope
findings.value: USD 7 = International Education Payment (Advance) only; NOT a general remittance price
findings.note: Item 2.2.7. Corrects ladder R02 step citing USD 7 as general Global Transfer price (F07). General Advance Global Transfer is USD 20 (V22).

findings.claim: U.S. currency reporting on entry (CMIR)
findings.value: >$10,000 currency/monetary instruments: FinCEN Form 105; e-file + 72-hour arrival rule
findings.note: CBP Know Before You Go. Old CBP URL returns 404 → corrected URL used (F06).

findings.claim: Reference CNY/USD rate for fee comparison
findings.value: 7.129 CNY per USD (IRS 2025 yearly average)
findings.note: Reference only, not an executable quote. Ladder uses 7.1; difference explained in costs reconciliation (F08).

findings.claim: U.S.-China income tax treaty existence
findings.value: 1984 treaty + technical explanation published by IRS
findings.note: Withholding-rate percentages NOT re-fetched → left blank (F05). Do not rely on any 10% figure from this session.

findings.claim: Bank FX spread / Wise / Western Union fees
findings.note: No official/provider static publication fetched this session. All spread/fee cells blank (F02/F03). Ladder 0.30-1.50% band is an assumption, not a quote.

findings.claim: Your personal PRC tax due / route eligibility / all-in cost
findings.note: Private facts unknown (balance source, years, tax paid, residence, filing history, bank quote). No personal amount computed (F01).

findings.claim: 2014 emigrant lump-sum amendment detail
findings.note: SAFE Huifa 2014-2 not re-fetched this session. 2004 installment text (S09) is what was verified. Left blank (F04).

findings.claim: Virtual-currency bridge legality in China
findings.value: Illegal financial activity; fiat-crypto exchange strictly prohibited
findings.note: Yinfa [2026] No. 42. Basis for rejecting M14.
